Maine: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Maine on the map

Key dates

  • In-person absentee (early) voting at your municipal clerk's office: October 5, 2026 to October 29, 2026. Hours vary by municipality. Check with your town or city clerk.
  • Deadline to register to vote online or by mail: October 13, 2026. You can still register in person at your town or city office at any time, including on Election Day. Registration through the BMV is open until October 27.
  • Last day to request an absentee (mail) ballot: October 29, 2026. Your clerk must receive the request by 5:00 p.m. Completed ballots must arrive by 8:00 p.m. on Election Day. It is recommended that you mail your ballot by October 27.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls close at 8:00 p.m., and anyone in line by then can vote. Opening times vary by municipality (between 6 a.m. and 10 a.m.).

Official election information: Maine Secretary of State – Elections and Voting

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.
